name: Terenthis
summary: Terenthis watches the corruption spreading through Darkshore from Auberdine. The Cenarion Circle sent the night elf druid to investigate its reach from Teldrassil and seek help from travelers and local allies.

sections.title: Investigating the Taint
sections.body: Terenthis investigates Fel Moss and other corruption in Darkshore. The Cenarion Circle sent him to Auberdine to track the blight spreading from Teldrassil. Night elves fear it may shatter the balance of northern Kalimdor. Terenthis seeks the cause of the rot and ways to stop it before it consumes the forests.

sections.title: A Plea from Grimclaw
sections.body: Grimclaw reaches Auberdine wounded and alone, seeking help from Terenthis. The druid recognizes that the bear’s master, Volcor, is in grave trouble. Unable to leave his post, Terenthis sends travelers into the wilderness to find Volcor, pinned down after an ambush by aggressive furbolg tribes.

faq.answer: Terenthis is a night elf druid of the Cenarion Circle, stationed in Auberdine, Darkshore.
The Cenarion Circle sent Terenthis to Auberdine to investigate Fel Moss and magical corruption spreading from Teldrassil into Darkshore, and to find a way to stop it.

faq.q: What is the bear beside Terenthis doing there?
aliases: why is there a bear in auberdine
faq.answer: Grimclaw came to Terenthis in Auberdine wounded and alone after his master, the druid Volcor, was ambushed and pinned down by aggressive furbolgs.

faq.q: What organization does Terenthis belong to?
faq.answer: Terenthis belongs to the Cenarion Circle, a druidic order that works to preserve balance and protect nature across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What threats is Terenthis most concerned with?
faq.answer: Terenthis fears the spread of Fel Moss corruption and the growing hostility of furbolg tribes, which threaten travelers and druids.

faq.q: Does Terenthis offer any tasks to adventurers?
faq.answer: Yes. Terenthis sends travelers to gauge threats along the coast, aid local allies, and help Volcor.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you stand with Terenthis against corruption spreading from Teldrassil into the mainland.
As a night elf, you share Terenthis’s concern for purifying your sacred lands of fel taint and protecting innocent forest life.
